title: The Combine's weapon check is a room that announces, holds you, charges, then takes and burns what you carry
rule: A Combine weapon check is a timed room, never a popup: whoever steps in is held still, a voice announces the check, machines round the room charge with a rising sound, then what is carried floats out of the hands and burns away, the room flares bright, and the way out opens. What cannot be taken (Valve's gravity gun) makes the machines spark and fail, a voice says the check failed, and the way opens anyway with a security warning. A check that takes players' things changes our contraband and checkpoint features: ask the owner first.
why: d3_citadel_03 room0 and ep1_citadel_01 (the same build): a trigger_once in the middle; at 0 trigger_vphysics_motion pins the player (gravity 2, velocity limit 8); at 2 s (1.5 in EP1) citadel.overwatch_weaponstrip (radius 1250); at 7 s strip_core1, four env_citadel_energy_core (scale 3) at the room's corners, StartCharge 4 with weapon_zapper_start and a loop; at 11 s trigger_weapon_strip Enable (killweapons No), the dropped weapons float in a second vphysics trigger (gravity 0, velocity limit 2, air density 0.5); at 13 s trigger_weapon_dissolve Enable, emitter info_targets at the four cores, the room light bright. trigger_weapon_dissolve OnChargingPhyscannon > sparks, overwatch_weaponstrip_fail at +1 s, the end relay at +4 s (strip and dissolve off, the exit wall Killed, the shield wall off, autosave), overwatch_weaponstrip_fail_security at +8 s. With nothing to fail, strip_stop does the same and the first squad comes 2 s later.
how: Gamemode (ask first): a Combine entry check for the Nexus or a Combine-only zone (docs/features/contraband.md, patdown-and-cuffs.md): stepping into a marked spot holds the player about 10 s, plays the Overwatch weapon-strip line and a charge sound, then takes the contraband (as a search does) with a dissolve effect on what is taken, and opens the door; told by sound and effect, no text (house rule 10). Map modules: a check-room piece with four energy-core points at the corners and an exit door the gamemode opens.

title: Combine power is a thing you can carry: pull the energy ball from its socket and what it feeds goes dark
rule: In the Citadel what powers a field, a lift or a bridge is an energy ball held in a socket, marked by a pair of glowing cores. Take the ball out and the thing it feeds switches off; put a ball back and it comes on again. Elsewhere dispensers hold a few balls that come back a few seconds after one is lost, and catchers count balls thrown in until enough are in. A new kind of job game or sabotage: ask the owner first.
why: d3_citadel_03: func_combine_ball_spawner with flag 8192 (power supply), ballcount 1, ballrespawntime -1 (never comes back), speed 75: ballspawner_ballgenerator1 OnLastBallGrabbed > relay_combineshieldwall3_off, OnBallReinserted > _on; ball_spawner_room3 holds wall 7; two env_citadel_energy_core (scale 1.5, one up, one down) at each socket. Dispensers: ballcount 10, respawn 4 s, speed 125 to 350, start inactive (4096), in rows 80 apart. ep1_citadel_03: catchers are trigger_multiples with filter_combineball_type (ball_trap_10 Add 1, its reset Subtracts 1): 2 balls per bridge section, 3 for the upper bridge, 6 for the core (counter_balltrap). 44 spawners in 9 maps, 17 launchers in EP1.
how: Gamemode (ask first): a sabotage or repair job game in the Nexus or a Combine post (docs/features/jobs-and-quests.md): carry a glowing ball (a prop) from a dispenser to a socket to power a door or field, or pull one out to drop a field; a hands-on step in place of any waiting (house rule 9). Map modules: a socket point with two core glows, wired to a named field or door.

title: A deadline is counted out loud by the Combine's voice, closer together near the end, while a machine climbs with it
rule: When something will happen at a set moment (Breen's teleport), the time left is spoken by Overwatch at 3 minutes, 2, 1, 45 seconds, 30, 15 and 10: the calls come closer together as the end nears, and a machine everyone can see moves on a step with the late calls. No clock on the screen. Ending the threat cancels the calls still to come. Our endings and the collapse are the owner's: changing how they count down, or adding spoken calls, is ask the owner first.

how: Gamemode (ask first): an ending or the collapse (docs/features/endings.md, collapse.md) that comes at a set time could have the city's dispatcher voice speak the time left at 3, 2, 1 min, 45, 30, 15 and 10 s, and stop the moment it is averted; a sound, never a line of text (house rule 10).

title: The Combine's masters are seen only on screens; staff work consoles under them, and the alarm comes when you are noticed
rule: The Advisor is never met in the Citadel: it is a face on the screens, cut in and out between other pictures with its hum, screens round the room coming on one by one with a click each. In the control room elites work consoles while it watches; when a player looks into the room (about half a second in sight) or a timeout runs out, the Advisor alerts, an alarm sounds and repeats, the screens go dark and the staff turn to fight. New for our Nexus or Combine quarter: ask the owner first.
why: ep1_citadel_01, 03, d3_breen_01: no npc_advisor; a cycler with models/Advisor.mdl in a sealed room, point_cameras fov 70 to 90, func_monitors. ep1_citadel_01 relay_advisor_monitor_fx: SetCamera between camera_advisor and camera_tv_breen 9 times from 0.5 to 3.6 s with the Advisor's ambient loop on and off in step; monitors 2 to 7 Enable at 4.3, 4.6, 4.9, 5.6, 6.2, 6.5 s with a monitor-on sound each; AdvisorAlert @3.5, AdvisorTalk @5; relay_bringoutpod_1 @7 (door, rail, turning light, alarm). ep1_citadel_03: console_actBusy ForceNPCToActBusy npc_elite_controltype_1 and _2 at console hints; Trigger_look_advisor (fieldofview .975, looktime 0.6) OnTrigger and OnTimeout > relay_enteringcorecontrol: AdvisorAlert @0, the elites Wake @0, assault Activate @0.13, relay_alarm1 @1, timer_alarm (8 s) Enable @1, Monitor_advisor_1 Disable @3. d3_breen_01: Breen pleads to it on Monitor_plead_console_1.
how: Gamemode (ask first): the Nexus or a Combine control room (docs/features/factions.md) could show an overseer's face on its screens for a few seconds at a time, cut in with static, and have Combine NPC staff at console spots who drop their work and fight when an intruder is seen for half a second. Map modules: console work spots (act busy hints) in Combine rooms and a screen surface named for the gamemode.

title: Defenders of the Citadel sleep until woken, and on a bridge each one's death wakes the next
rule: Most of the Citadel's soldiers are placed asleep, waiting for a word, and are woken by what the player does (a door opened, a pipe broken, a look into a room) or by a comrade's death; on long bridges each defender's death wakes the next, so they come one at a time, in order, never all at once. Changing how our Combine defenders are spawned or woken: ask the owner first.

Elites (combine_super_soldier) are 20 to 44% of the Citadel's soldiers (5 of 25 in d3_citadel_03, 12 of 58 in 04, 26 of 59 in ep1_citadel_03).
how: Gamemode (ask first): a raid on the Nexus (docs/features/city.md) could keep its inner defenders idle at posts until the raiders reach their stretch, and wake the next post when one falls, instead of all at once.

title: A place falling apart rumbles at random and its broken machines spark on their own
rule: Once a place is breaking, let it say so by itself: every 12 to 49 seconds at random, a shake felt across the area with a far explosion and a scrape heard further still, and a second sound some time later; a story beat gets a harder, shorter shake. Each broken console sparks on its own random timer (every half a second to 2 seconds), switched on by whatever broke it and off a while after. No text. Fits our endings and the collapse, which are the owner's: ask the owner first before adding it to them.
why: ep1_citadel_01, 03, styleguide_destroyed_citadel: timer_rumble random 12 to 49 s (8 to 33 in ep1_citadel_02) > relay_rumble_random: shake_rumble_02 (amplitude 4, 4 s, frequency 120, radius 5000), citadel_ep01.ambient_explosion (radius 9000), a second sound @25. Story rumble relay_rumble_01: amplitude 12 for 1 s, then 4 for 4 s at 0.95, two sounds. 121 of the 15 maps' 209 logic_timers drive sparks, random 0.4 to 2 s, all start disabled and are Enabled by the relay that breaks the thing (d3_citadel_03 relay_consoleN_start_fx: explosion, sparks 2 s, timers on, stop at 10 s, the console's skin to 1).
how: Gamemode (ask first): during the collapse or an ending's run-up (docs/features/collapse.md, endings.md), a city-wide random rumble every 12 to 49 s (screen shake 4 for 4 s, a far explosion sound); a Combine console or terminal that is wrecked sparks on a random 0.4 to 2 s timer for about 10 s.

title: The Citadel shows its work in passing: workers busy at their task, a guard watching, there only while someone goes by
rule: What the Combine does is shown, not told: stalkers at work with cables hanging to what they mend and sparks beside them, a soldier standing watching one, synths walking through a bay, one pod carrying a stalker past with a shriek. They appear just before someone comes past and are removed after. Fits a Combine quarter or Nexus as scenery; new NPC kinds there: ask the owner first.
why: d3_citadel_02: npc_stalker_busy1 to 3 on scripted_sequences (play working or idle2, flags 480 and 496), move_rope and keyframe_rope to their work, env_spark beside; npc_soldier_watchstalker3 beside busy3; spawned by point_templates when the player's pod passes pod_player12 (ForceSpawn @0 and @2) and Killed at pod_player2 and pod_player23; the gunship bay's stalker walks a 6-corner loop (aiscripted_schedule 4 s after the template spawns). d3_citadel_05: stalkerpod1 (a prop_dynamic stalker in a prisoner pod) at speed 70 over 1229, d3_citadel.stalker_shriek2 and breathing @2 at one node, shriek1 at the next; two crab synths walk path_gunshipbay_synths 1.5 s after the player's pod passes pod_player32 and are Killed at the path's end.
how: Gamemode (ask first): Combine scenery spots in the Nexus or Combine quarter, filled with a working NPC (a stalker at a panel with sparks, a guard idling beside) while a player is within reach and emptied after, as the life spots of valve-lift-diorama.

extra.how: The Citadel's pod rings keep in step another way (d3_citadel_01, 04, 05, ep1_citadel_00): 7 pods on a ring of 14 path_tracks (4749 long, speed 100), each stopping at its own node (OnPass !activator Stop) and adding 1 to one math_counter (max 7); OnHitMax fires the resume relay 3 s later (4 s on the other ring) and resets the counter, so the slowest pod holds the rest and the ring never drifts; one stop is a job (the zapper: warm-up @2.5, energy core discharge, beam, sparks and a trigger_hurt @4, all off 6 s later), another opens the pod (rotator Open @0, pod @1, Close @4 and @5). Diggers on 2-node rings are started by one logic_auto at 1, 4 and 6 s so they never move together.

The Citadel's shield walls (d3_citadel_03, 7 of them) add two things: a trigger_hurt of 10000 that the on relay Enables and Disables 0.1 s later, so whatever stands in the field as it rises dies; and the field fed by an energy ball in a socket (func_combine_ball_spawner flag 8192: OnLastBallGrabbed > off relay, OnBallReinserted > on relay; valve-ball-socket-power). The clip brush's excludednpc npc_combine_s lets the soldiers through; the poles' Skin 1 when off.

d3_citadel_04's lift wait caps the living, not the dead: a logic_timer of 4 to 10 s picks one of 8 cases (three doors with env_entity_makers of 3 soldiers, or manhacks) only while fewer than 4 are alive (soldier_counter: each spawn Adds 3, each death Subtracts 1; OutValue > logic_compare 4 Enables or Disables the timer); 6 waves are allowed until the lift is called, then the timer narrows to 2 to 5 s and 12 more are allowed; the lift's first stop Kills the timer. The stasis room does the same with 3 alive and 8 waves.

Where the player must fight with the gravity gun alone, Valve leaves no guns at all: in ep1_citadel_01 and 04 every soldier's death dissolves his weapon (10 of 10 and 13 of 13: OnDeath > env_entity_dissolver Dissolve soldierX_weapon).

Breen's broadcasts in d3_citadel_03 and 04 come through one point_camera (fov 20) aimed at npc_breen in a booth far from the play, shown on every console's func_monitor; a func_brush slate in front of that camera blanks all the screens at once: the slate tone plays (at 2 and 5 s), the slate is Disabled (at 6 s, or 0.5 s after the tone) and Breen's scene starts (at 9 s, or 0.6 s); his speeches chain OnCompletion 2 s apart.

d3_citadel_02's pod ride is the same idea at the Citadel's scale: 56 path_tracks, 24581 units, about 147 s at 100 to 250, 13 nodes that set something off (a thing to see about every 11 s): the next hall's door Opens as the pod nears and the last Closes behind it, workers and guards are ForceSpawned ahead and Killed behind, container trains on a 15206 ring start 0, 2 and 4 s apart as the pod passes.
